extracted.finding: The $399 figure the original report treated as an unreconciled CONFLICT with $349 is better characterized as a SUPERSEDED pre-approval announcement, not a live competing price.
extracted.provenance_of_399: Announced 2025-11-06 in the Lilly / U.S. government agreement on obesity medicines: orforglipron to be available with the lowest dose starting at $149 with additional doses up to $399, via TrumpRx and LillyDirect.
extracted.provenance_of_349: Post-launch regular top-tier self-pay price located on foundayo.lilly.com after the 2026-04-01 approval and 2026-04-06 LillyDirect launch.
extracted.correct_characterization: Sequence, not conflict: $399 was an announced pre-launch ceiling; the located post-launch regular ceiling is $349, with a conditional $299 for continuous refills. Reporting also states Lilly 'lowered its price, saying it will sell the pill at up to $299 a month if patients continually renew their prescription'.
